scope: Read-only source audit of RecoveryService descriptor/cursor call chains, plus authorized test-fixture corrections. No product change or new build in this pass.
buffered_descriptor_audit: FileRecoveryRandomAccessSource is constructed over a freshly opened archive stream. Production reads go through RandomAccess from the first read; magic/hash wrappers read its RecoveryRandomAccessStream, not the underlying buffered FileStream.

ReadRecoveryPackageAsync reads sidecar locators and encoded metadata using TryReadAtAsync/ReadAtOffsetAsync/RandomAccess. The sequential parser reads concern RecoveryMetadataStream envelope/payload, not the recovery FileStream.

Generated-sidecar writes are FlushAsync/Flush(true)-completed before commit verification. Locator/metadata verification begins with awaited serial RandomAccess reads before later parallel parity reads.
The separate candidate is copied with RandomAccess, flushed, and then repaired by parallel RandomAccess reads/writes. The later full hash and magic probe occur after all repair workers join.

The repeated SafeFileHandle getter remains a future maintenance concern if buffered reads are added, but no present production call chain retaining a nonempty FileStream read buffer into parallel getter access was identified. No speculative product edit was made.
